answer:
Based on my research, here's what I found:

## Analysis of Books Meeting All Criteria

Looking for romance books released in 2023 that:
1. Were in the **Top 10 most sold fiction books in Canada by print sales volume** in 2023
2. Appeared on the **New York Times "Combined Print & E-Book Fiction"** list for **more than 20 consecutive weeks in 2023**

### Top 10 Bestselling Fiction Books in Canada (2023 Print Sales - BookNet Canada):
1. ***Meet Me at the Lake*** by Carley Fortune ✖️🍁
2. *Everyone Here Is Lying* by Shari Lapena
3. *The Defector* by Chris Hadfield
4. *Five Little Indians* by Michelle Good
5. *A Death at the Party* by Amy Stuart
6. *The Whispers* by Ashley Audrain
7. *The Lie Maker* by Linwood Barclay
8. *The Drowning Woman* by Robyn Harding
9. *The Sleeping Car Porter* by Suzette Mayr
10. *Everything She Feared* by Rick Mofina

### Genre Classification:
Among these 10 titles, only *****Meet Me at the Lake*** by Carley Fortune** is a confirmed **romance novel**. The other 9 are primarily mystery, thriller, crime, or literary fiction.

### New York Times Performance:
From my search results on the NYT Combined Print & E-Book Fiction list during 2023:
- *Meet Me at the Lake* debuted on the NYT Combined list in late May 2023 (May 21 issue)
- It continued to appear through at least June/July 2023
- However, based on available NYT snapshot data, it does NOT appear to have maintained 20+ consecutive weeks on the Combined Print & E-Book Fiction list within the calendar year 2023

Other notable romance books like Colleen Hoover's *It Starts with Us* and *It Ends with Us* did dominate the NYT list for extended periods in 2023 (with *It Starts with Us* spending 10 weeks at #1 alone), BUT:
- *It Starts with Us* was published in October 2022 (not 2023)
- Neither book appeared in the Top 10 Canadian print sales list

---

## Conclusion

**There appears to be NO romance book that meets ALL three criteria:**
1. Released in 2023 ✓
2. Top 10 most sold fiction in Canada by print sales ✓  
3. Appeared on NYT Combined Print & E-Book Fiction list for 20+ consecutive weeks in 2023 ✓

***Meet Me at the Lake*** is the closest match, being both a 2023 romance release AND a Top 10 Canadian bestseller, but it does not appear to have achieved 20+ consecutive weeks on the NYT Combined Fiction list within 2023 specifically.

# Bestselling Canadian books of 2023

January 8, 2024

[Research & Analysis]

At the end of last year, we showed you the [bestselling books of 2023]. Before we get too far into this year, let’s look at the bestselling books by Canadian contributors last year.

The following lists are based on print sales volume in Canada from January 1, 2023, to December 3, 2023, according to [SalesData], BookNet’s national sales tracking service for the Canadian English-language trade book market.

## [Top 10 bestselling Fiction books by Canadians in 2023]

[![Image 2: Covers of Meet Me at the Lake by Carley Fortune, Everyone Here Is Lying by Shari Lapena, and The Defector by Chris Hadfield]]

1. _Meet Me at the Lake_ by Carley Fortune🍁 (9780735243781)

2. _Everyone Here Is Lying_ by Shari Lapena🍁 (9780385698900)

3. _The Defector_ by Chris Hadfield🍁 (9781039005402)

4. _Five Little Indians_ by Michelle Good🍁 (9781443459181)

5. _A Death at the Party_ by Amy Stuart🍁 (9781668009109)

6. _The Whispers_ by Ashley Audrain🍁 (9780735239937)

7. _The Lie Maker_ by Linwood Barclay🍁 (9780063320598)

8. _The Drowning Woman_ by Robyn Harding🍁 (9781538756966)

9. _The Sleeping Car Porter_ by Suzette Mayr🍁 (9781552454589)

10. _Everything She Feared_ by Rick Mofina🍁 (9780778334378)

You can see all of these titles in this CataList catalogue: [Bestselling Titles in Canada in 2023 – Canadian Fiction].

This list is quite different from [last year’s top 10], with the exception of Michelle Good’s _Five Little Indians_, which was in the number one spot last year, and remains on this year’s list. Carley Fortune also returns to the list in 2023, but with a different book in 2023 than last year; in 2022, _Every Summer After_ was number two on the list.

Similar to last year, the majority of the books on this list, 80%, were frontlist — published in 2023. And there was one lone hardcover (Chris Hadfield’s _The Defector_) the rest were paperbacks.

## [Top 10 bestselling Non-Fiction books by Canadians in 2023]

[![Image 3: Covers of Fraiche Food, Fuller Hearts by Jillian Harris and Tori Wessze, Outlive by Peter Attia and Bill Gifford, and The Myth of Normal by Gabor Maté and Daniel Maté]]

1. _Fraiche Food, Fuller Hearts_ by Jillian Harris🍁 and Tori Wesszer🍁 (9780735240780)

2. _Outlive_ by Peter Attia🍁 and Bill Gifford (9780593236598)

3. _The Myth of Normal_ by Gabor Maté🍁 and Daniel Maté 🍁(9780735278363)

4. _Friends, Lovers, and the Big Terrible Thing_ by Matthew Perry🍁 (9781250866448)

5. _12 Rules for Life_ by Jordan B. Peterson🍁 (9780345816023)

6. _The Road Years_ by Rick Mercer🍁 (9780385688901)

7. _Ducks_ by Kate Beaton🍁 (9781770462892)

8. _When the Body Says No_ by Gabor Maté🍁 (9780676973129)

9. _My Effin’ Life_ by Geddy Lee🍁 (9780063159419)

10. _Love, Pamela_ by Pamela Anderson🍁 (9780063226562)

You can see all of these titles in this CataList catalogue: [Bestselling Titles in Canada in 2023 – Canadian Non-Fiction].

There’s more overlap between the[2022] and 2023 Non-Fiction lists. Four books were repeats: _The Myth of Normal_ by Gabor Maté and Daniel Maté; _Friends, Lovers, and the Big Terrible Thing_ by Matthew Perry; _12 Rules for Life_ by Jordan B. Peterson; and _When the Body Says No_ by Gabor Maté.

And on the flip side from the Fiction list above, there was only one paperback edition (_When the Body Says No_ by Gabor Maté) on the list, the remaining nine were all hardcovers.

## [Top 10 bestselling Juvenile and Young Adult books by Canadians in 2023]

[![Image 4: Covers of Love You Forever by Robert Munsch, illus. by Sheila McGraw in three formats]]

1. _Love You Forever_ by Robert Munsch,🍁 illus. by Sheila McGraw (Paperback) (9780920668375)

2. _Love You Forever_ by Robert Munsch,🍁 illus. by Sheila McGraw (Board book) (9780228101048)

3. _Love You Forever_ by Robert Munsch,🍁 illus. by Sheila McGraw (Hardcover) (9780920668368)

4. _Every Child Matters_ by Phyllis Webstad,🍁 illus by Karlene Harvey (9781778540165)

5. _The Paper Bag Princess_ by Robert Munsch,🍁 illus. by Michael Martchenko🍁 (9781773210292)

6. _I Hope_ by Monique Gray Smith,🍁 illus. by Gabrielle Grimard🍁 (9781459825932)

7. _Braiding Sweetgrass for Young Adults_ by Robin Wall Kimmerer and Monique Gray Smith,🍁 illus. by Nicole Neidhardt (9781728458991)

8. _The Barren Grounds_ by David A. Robertson🍁 (9780735266124)

9. _Dear Girl,_ by Amy Krouse Rosenthal and Paris Rosenthal, illus. by Holly Hatam 🍁 (9780062422507)

10. _The Tryout: A Graphic Novel_ by Christina Soontornvat, illus. by Joanna Cacao 🍁 (9781338741261)

You can see all of these titles in this CataList catalogue: [Bestselling Titles in Canada in 2023 – Canadian Juvenile & YA].

It seems as though Canadian book buyers will love _Love You Forever_ forever – top spot since[2019]. Three different editions of the classic Robert Munsch title take the top three spots on the list this year. They were all on[last year’s list], too, along with the other Robert Munch classic, _The Paper Bag Princess_. _The Barren Grounds_ by David A. Robertson was the last title to appear on both this year’s and last year’s lists.

The only title on the list published in 2023 was _Every Child Matters_ by Phyllis Webstad. The rest were backlist.
